title: Introducing Separate COE Category for Point-to-Point Vehicle Services
what_it_is: Introducing Separate COE Category for Point-to-Point Vehicle Services

sections.label: P2P industry review
sections.summary: The review of the point-to-point industry structure and regulatory framework covers availability, resilience and inclusivity, with engagement of tripartite partners, commuters and drivers, targeted for completion in the second half of 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The ongoing review of the point-to-point (P2P) industry structure and regulatory framework covers the availability, resilience and inclusivity of P2P services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: As part of the review, we have been engaging the tripartite partners, as well as commuters and drivers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We target to complete the review by the second half of 2024.

sections.label: Separate COE category for private hire cars
sections.summary: A separate COE category for private hire cars is not ruled out, but sizing its quota is challenging because demand evolves and reallocating quotas from Categories A and B could affect COE and ride hail fare prices.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As mentioned before by the Minister for Transport both in this House and to the press, we are not ruling out the idea of having a separate COE category for private hire cars.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The key challenge is in sizing the quota to be set aside for this category, especially since the demand for private hire car services continues to evolve.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Given the current sizeable population of private hire cars, what it means is that we will have to reallocate the existing quotas from Category A and Category B for this separate category.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: If we overestimate the demand, that would mean that there will be a tight quota constraint on Categories A and B, and that, of course, would have a knock-on effect on COE prices.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: On the other hand, if we underestimate the demand, that means, we size the quota smaller than what it ought to be, then that could result in insufficient private hire car supply, and that could impact ride hail fare prices.
